quote: the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.
why: The judge text uses 1 Chronicles 28:6 and Acts 1:8 only as footing for the challenger's analogy and never counts them as an unanswered witness, so the rule's counting condition does not apply to this text.
